figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC

parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id
parts.note: 数据来自 表 categories、中间结果 a、中间结果 b，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 gmroi DESC 排列结果。

figures.title: 库存投资回报率的口径

scope.label: 平均库存
scope.text: 使用2024年底和2025年底各仓库存标准成本估算平均库存

figures.pitfall: 库存投资回报以平均库存成本为分母；毛利率以净销售为分母；库存周转率以销售成本为分子，不能互换。
